status: Manual transcription with sample visual verification; requires per-model review and live read tests before enabling writes

access_legend.Restricted: manufacturer-only or protected administrative operation, never normal restore

address_rule: For P hex group F0..FF with function index converted DECIMAL->HEX; A group A0..AF; U group 70..7F. E.g. P0-16 => 0xF010; U0-11 => 0x700B.
critical_notes: Access classification is based on the supplied manuals; not hardware verified.
An RW access label does not alone authorize Restore: verify range, machine stopped and firmware compatibility.
Default_value is null when manual says model-dependent or does not specify a default.
min_value and max_value are null for dynamic constraints and enumerations; setting_range_text preserves the source.
The scanned manual marks P9-00..P9-13 with filled circle read-only symbols; review_notes flag this surprising classification.
Function code access is not a guarantee that a given device firmware accepts a Modbus write.
U0 and communication status should not be restored even if present in a backup. P9 entries are allowed only where access=RW and after full validation.
The main manual uses PD group, while separate protocol uses Fd for communication parameters, with potentially different PD-05/Fd-05 defaults.
The quoted 0x1007 Running speed register has no verified RPM scaling. Estimate RPM from frequency and rated motor data when appropriate.
The additional Modbus protocol lists A groups not present in the supplied main manual; absent definitions are not fabricated.
The manual skips some code numbers intentionally; the library includes documented rows, not every integer between the first and last code.
